provenance.l: Apollo 12 Mission Report MSC-01855 (Mar 1970): Table 5-I (liftoff 142:03:48, docking 145:36:20, ascent stage jettison 147:59:32), Table 5-VI (ascent propulsion 6,057.0 ft/s), Table 5-VIII (TEI 172:27:16.8, 130.3 s, 3,042.0 ft/s), range zero 16:22:00 GMT 14 November 1969. Quote: "Transearth injection Service propulsion 172:27:16.8 130.3 3042.0"

NASA SP-4029 Apollo 12 summary: "The 434-second burn was 1.2 seconds longer than planned"; "placed the spacecraft into an orbit of 51.93 by 9.21 n mi at 142:10:59.9"; CSI 143:01:51.0 (41.1 s), CDH 144:00:02.6 (13.0 s), TPI 144:36:26 (26.0 s), TPF 145:19:29.3 (38.0 s). The Mission Report's Table 5-VI lists a 423.2 s burn and a 46.3 x 8.8 n.mi orbit (likely pre-trim); the SP-4029 figures are used. Apollo 12 flew the same CSI/CDH/TPI/TPF sequence as Apollo 11
Apollo Flight Journal, Apollo 12: LM jettison and the CSM orbit ("an apolune of 62.6 nautical miles, perilune of 57 nautical miles"); Apollo 12 entry and splashdown
